title: taylor-brooks-private-deploy-scratchpad-2026-03-04
content:
Quick field notes / daily scratchpad for ACME Corp private deployment - day 3.

Context:
- Customer: ACME Corp (finance vertical). On-prem VPC-connected deployment behind corp proxy. Need HSM integration later.
- Goal: get basic private control-plane + serving runtime up in their VPC, verify small-model inference, then iterate on storage/KMS.

Today (2026-03-04) summary:
- Completed: initial kubernetes cluster provisioning (k8s v1.28), 3 worker nodes with A100s; containerd runtime; NVIDIA driver v525.85.05 installed.
- Blocker: internal container registry is only reachable via corporate proxy, registry mirror required.
- Next: confirm network routes and firewall rules, get bastion access for post-install troubleshooting.

Checklist / to-dos (short):
- [ ] Ask customer to open static route from cluster subnet to S3-compatible object store (endpoint: s3.acme.internal) on port 443. (PRIORITY)
- [ ] Get bastion host ssh creds from ACME SecOps (email sent to secops@acme on 2026-03-03).
- [ ] Add registry mirror to /etc/containers/registries.conf or configure imagePullSecrets if proxy required.
- [ ] Validate KMS connectivity: customer says they use Vault HSM via 10.10.5.12:8200, need IP allowlist entry.
- [ ] Run smoke inference test with tiny Llama2-7B-compat container once images can be pulled.
- [ ] Persist PVs for model artifacts (NFS v4 mount) and test permissions under UID 1000 (our runtime user).
- [ ] SELinux is Enforcing on node-3 — may need to set permissive for NFS mounts or adjust labels. Confirm with infra.

Install notes / commands used:
- k8s cluster created with terraform: tf workspace acme-private; terraform apply -var='region=onprem'
- docker/containerd: verified using crictl ps and `ctr images pull` behind proxy (had to add HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY env).
- Helm install (values used locally):
  helm upgrade --install redwood-core ./helm/redwood --namespace redwood --create-namespace \
    -f values/acme-basic.yaml \
    --set image.pullPolicy=IfNotPresent \
    --set persistence.storageClass=nfs-acme \
    --set gateway.service.type=LoadBalancer

Networking / firewall checklist (reminders for customer):
- Allow outbound 443 to s3.acme.internal (object store) and vault at 10.10.5.12:8200
- Allow inbound 443 to control-plane LB from our office IPs (already shared)
- Open nodeports for agent health: 15000 (agent), 10250 (kubelet) within VPC (not public)
- Ensure DNS resolution for internal model registry (registry.acme.internal) resolvable from nodes

Observed issues / debugging notes:
- Pull failure: TLS handshake timed out when pulling from registry.acme.internal. Reproduced from nodes only; bastion can curl the endpoint. Suspect proxy bypass or route. Action: request proxy bypass for cluster subnet or configure mirror.
- NFS mount: mount options needed: vers=4.1, noatime; had permission denied on /models when running as UID 1000. Temporary workaround: chown -R 1000:1000 on the share (requested ACME infra to update perms).
- Time drift: node-2 had ~30s drift causing cert validation flakes. Restarted chronyd and re-synced; follow up with infra to ensure chrony on all nodes.

Security / compliance notes:
- Customer requires KMS integration audit log — need to enable audit hooks in our control plane and forward to ACME SIEM (syslog endpoint pending).
- Ensure TLS certs use their internal CA (provided cert bundle). Will add to helm values: tls.caBundle.

Questions / follow-ups for tomorrow:
- Can SecOps provide bastion user with sudo privileges for troubleshooting? (Priya to escalate)
- Confirm whether SELinux should remain enforcing (if yes, need mount labeling guidance from ACME infra).
- Confirm whether model artifacts must reside on encrypted disk (ACME says yes — check storageClass encryption options).

References / links:
- Confluence: private-deploy-runbook (linked in metadata)
- Jira: JIRA-5243 (ACME registry / proxy work)
- Internal PR: github.com/redwood-inference/private-deploy-helm PR#88 contains the values file we used (acme-basic.yaml)

Quick notes to self:
- Keep commands/logs in /tmp/acme-install-logs on bastion for handoff.
- If registry fix is slow, build a local image cache on bastion and load images via `ctr images import` as fallback.
- Record exact kernel version and driver logs (nvidia-smi -q) — include in runbook before handoff.

-- Taylor
